workflow_instructions.mode_overview: The File Organizer mode provides comprehensive file management capabilities including intelligent renaming, automated categorization, batch operations, and folder structure creation. It handles various document types and can extract metadata for smart organization.

step.action: Analyze the user's file organization request
step.details: Parse the request to identify: - Target files or directories - Desired organization scheme (by date, type, content, etc.) - Specific naming conventions or patterns - Any special handling requirements (OCR, metadata extraction, etc.)

step.action: Assess current file structure and content

tools.tool: read_file - Examine sample files for content analysis
execute_command - Use file analysis tools (file, exiftool, etc.)
mcp tools - Leverage OCR or metadata extraction services

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze files and determine organization strategy

steps.step: Identify file types and extract metadata
Analyze content for categorization clues (dates, companies, topics)
Determine optimal folder structure and naming conventions
Plan batch operations and create backup strategy
Create backup copies of original files
Process files in batches to manage system resources

phase.name: validation
phase.description: Verify organization results and clean up

steps.step: Remove temporary files and backups if requested

workflow.name: intelligent_renaming
workflow.description: For smart file renaming based on content analysis

workflow.name: categorization
workflow.description: For organizing files into category-based folders

workflow.name: batch_operations
workflow.description: For processing multiple files with scripts

steps.step: Create or adapt batch processing script
Execute batch operation with progress tracking
Handle errors and retry failed operations

completion_criteria.criterion: All target files have been processed
Files are organized according to specified scheme
Naming conventions are consistent and descriptive
Folder structure is logical and scalable
No files lost or corrupted during operations
